reviews.title: I really wanted it to be good!
reviews.text: Works ok. App crashed 3 times in the first 2 hours of my drive causing me to reenter my destination multiple times while driving in the rain on the interstate. I understand the data needs to refresh but the whole screen flashing gets annoying and I my directions stopped showing up on the screen except the blue line. No warning of getting off one interstate onto another or taking an exit unless I kept looking at the screen. If you zoom in to actual overview like any other gps you lose the weather overlay which is the entire point of the app. I can’t justify paying for it.

reviews.title: Do not pay for this App!! (And creator:  you need to fix this!!!)
reviews.text:
I purchased the pro version of the app because I drive a lot for my job and to visit friends and family.  I recently asked for a route because I was worried about flooding.  I live near a major freeway and the app should automatically pick that as the route.  Instead, it has me driving as the crow flies.  In addition, all the times displayed were wrong (this is new).  

I can’t change the route by adding points (all the points are also placed on the previous route it gave me).  I tried just selecting the freeway and despite that, it had me driving along the frontage road.  I also can’t drag the route where I would like it.  This is frustrating and has happened before.  Surely the app could be changed to allow those of us who purchase it to drag the route where we’d like it.  For flooding, severe weather or road closures it is important to have the route that will be driven.  

This is why I spent good money on this app.  

Oh, and btw hitting app support just takes you to a web page, not to where you can send a message.  That is why I added a new title to my review and changed the rating downwards.

reviews.title: Not at all accurate for road conditions
reviews.text:
OnTheWayApp gets one thing right: temperature forecasts and the “chain up / carry chains” zones were accurate. That’s it.

Everything else has been unreliable. Multiple times on high-mileage trips this past week, the app showed clear road conditions and clear weather when that was absolutely not the case. It repeatedly failed to flag the stuff that actually matters for travel—slick and icy roads, fog, snowy conditions, and other hazards you need to know about before you commit to a route.

If you’re using this to make real trip decisions, don’t. Verify conditions through official state road and weather sites instead. This app has failed every single time I’ve needed it.
